description.narrative: The Higher Council for the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (HCD) has a mandate to oversee, coordinate, and advance the full realisation of rights for persons with disabilities in Jordan. HCD’s areas of intervention cover inclusive education, employment and vocational training, accessibility of infrastructure and public services, political participation, and legal capacity. The Council provides technical expertise, advocates for systemic reform, and supports institutions meeting accessibility and inclusion standards. It also monitors and reports on compliance and leads public awareness campaigns. As Jordan’s national technical authority on disability rights, HCD is committed to enhancing educational performance and outcomes for all students with disabilities.
